definitions.gloss: suppression; subjugation; gaining control by force
definitions.explanation: Using force or authority to bring a situation, area, or group under control. Often used in military, security, and sports contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴動|ぼうどう}→暴動：15533_boudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制圧|せいあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{制圧|せいあつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police gained control of the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧な{攻撃力|こうげきりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{制圧|せいあつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They dominated the opposing team with overwhelming offensive power.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (control/restrain) + {圧|あつ} (pressure). Implies the use of force or overwhelming power to bring something under control.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制圧|せいあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to suppress, to subdue
- ⟦{武力|ぶりょく}→武力：13221_buryoku⟧{制圧|せいあつ}: armed suppression
- {制圧|せいあつ}⟦{射撃|しゃげき}→射撃：16089_shageki⟧: suppressive fire
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{制圧|せいあつ}: complete subjugation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鎮圧|ちんあつ}→鎮圧：14542_chinatsu⟧: suppression, quelling — focuses on calming a disturbance
- ⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧: control — managing or regulating something (less forceful)
- ⟦{征服|せいふく}→征服：12546_seifuku⟧: conquest — complete subjugation of a people or territory
- ⟦{弾圧|だんあつ}→弾圧：08999_danatsu⟧: oppression — suppressing people or movements through force
